Case note: CC/2548/2023
Client: Priyanka Apte (schoolteacher, Surat)
Opposing party: M/s Meridian Traders
Court: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Surat
Filed on: 02/05/2023
Claim amount: INR 15,40,000/-
Issue: cheque bounce. The cheque came back with the remark account closed.
Advice given: Treat the closure of the account as evidence of dishonest intent and oppose any compounding below the full cheque amount.
Outcome: The court issued summons and the drawer offered a settlement.
Recommended next step: Insist on payment of the full amount with costs.
